::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 21st 1882  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 113[^1]
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

I shall be happy to accept the terms you propose for the American Edition of my books. I hope they will spell their names better than in an advertisement I saw the other day of Ps and Os- and the Blest Woman of the Family- besides other pleasing inaccuracies[^2]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Endorsed ‘See letter of  Mr Craik to Miss Yonge June 1820 1882 xlii Letter Book Folio 352’.
[^2]: Her novels *P's and Q's, or, The Question of Putting Upon* (1872) and *The Clever Woman of the Family* (1865).
